subject.title: [Feature]: Discord thread-reply mention gate — respond to thread starter freely, require mention for follow-up replies

question: Should Discord add an additive autoThread follow-up mention-gate config, reuse a broader thread requireMention/requireExplicitMention shape, or keep bot-owned autoThread continuation as-is?
rationale: The request changes public Discord config and which thread replies reach the agent, so the durable API and compatibility default need maintainer direction before implementation.

options.title: Add an additive autoThread follow-up gate
options.body: Introduce an opt-in Discord config that keeps current defaults but requires explicit mention for later replies in bot-created autoThreads.

options.title: Fold into a general thread mention override
options.body: Resolve this only through the broader parent-versus-thread policy tracked at https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/75938, accepting that it must explicitly cover autoThread starter/follow-up semantics.

options.title: Keep current autoThread continuation
options.body: Decline the new config surface and document that bot-owned autoThreads intentionally continue without mention.

recommendation.title: Add an additive autoThread follow-up gate
recommendation.body: Introduce an opt-in Discord config that keeps current defaults but requires explicit mention for later replies in bot-created autoThreads.

likelyOwner.reason: The central policy question sits on the shared mention-gating path introduced in commit 625fd5b3e3e2 and used by Discord preflight.
